name: Account Mandate Maintenance Request V 05
definition: The AccountMandateMaintenanceRequest message is sent from an organisation to a financial institution as part of the account maintenance process. It is the initial request message to update one or several accounts. Usage: this update is only about mandate information. |If modification codes are not used: the organisation will specify under the “Mandate” and “Group” tags the complete information as it should be in the financial institution’s records after processing the update request. |If modification codes are used (in that case, they must be used everywhere): the organisation will specify under the “Mandate” and “Group” tags which elements must be added, deleted, modified, or if they are unchanged.|It is not possible to update the account characteristics or organisation information with this message.

References.name: References
References.definition: Set of elements for the identification of the message and related references.

From.name: From
From.definition: Identifies the business sender of the message, if it is not the account owner or account servicing financial institution.

UnderlyingMasterAgreement.name: Underlying Master Agreement
UnderlyingMasterAgreement.definition: Account contract established between the organisation or the group to which the organisation belongs, and the account servicer. This contract has to be applied for the new account to be opened and maintained.

AccountIdentification.name: Account Identification
AccountIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the account between the account owner and the account servicer.

AccountServicerIdentification.name: Account Servicer Identification
AccountServicerIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier of a financial institution, as assigned under an internationally recognised or proprietary identification scheme.

OrganisationIdentification.name: Organisation Identification
OrganisationIdentification.definition: Identification of the organisation requesting the change.

Group.name: Group
Group.definition: Definition of a group of parties.

AdditionalMessageInformation.name: Additional Message Information
AdditionalMessageInformation.definition: Contains additional information related to the message.

DigitalSignature.name: Digital Signature
DigitalSignature.definition: Contains the signature with its components, namely signed info, signature value, key info and the object.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
